The '''XJ-2 airspeeder''' was a model [[airspeeder]]<ref name="VE" /> that existed the final years of the [[Galactic Republic]]. The XJ-2 airspeeder was similar in design and designation to<ref name="ROTS" /> the [[XJ-6 airspeeder]] by [[Narglatch AirTech]].<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> One customized red and silver XJ-2 with blue seats was owned by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan]].<ref name="VE" />

==History== 
During the [[Clone Wars]]<ref name="Pursuit of Peace">{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}}</ref> in [[21 BBY]],<ref name="Pursuit Date">{{TCWcanondates|311}}</ref> [[Galactic Republic]] [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]] of [[Alderaan]] was preparing to leave with his parked XJ-2 airspeeder from a [[hangar]] to deliver a speech to the [[Galactic Senate]] against a [[Republic military enhancement bill|bill that would escalate the war effort]]. However, after opening the hangar's doors, he was attacked by the [[bounty hunter]]s [[Robonino]] and [[Chata Hyoki]] who had been sent by [[Count]] [[Dooku]] to take him out and prevent his speech and as such the bill. While [[GU-series Guardian police droid|police droids]] and [[Alderaan Guard]]s worked to apprehend the hired guns, Organa attempted to leave the hangar in his XJ-2 speeder, only to crash it into the hangar entrance when the vehicle was hit by [[blaster]] fire from Hyoki. Although Robonino and Hyoki were apprehended, Organa sustained injuries from the crash and was unable to deliver a speech to the Senate.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" />

XJ-2 airspeeders were also used on other planets like [[Onderon]]. During the [[Onderonian Civil War]],<ref name="Front Runners" /> in [[20 BBY]],<ref name="FrontR Date">{{TCWcanondates|503}}</ref> the [[Onderon rebels]] fighting against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the [[capital]] city [[Iziz]] loaded a blue XJ-2 speeder with munitions, then left it in the path of a Separatist [[battle droid]] patrol in one of Iziz's streets. Once the [[droid]] patrol arrived, the rebels detonated the bomb-laden speeder, manipulating the Separatists into dispatching reinforcements to the site in the form of an [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I]] which the rebels then used [[Attack on the Onderon power generator|to destroy]] Iziz's [[Onderon power generator|power generator]].<ref name="Front Runners" />

At the the sudden end of the Clone Wars<ref name="ROTS" /> in [[19 BBY]],<ref name="RotS Date">{{FilmDate|III}}</ref> Organa used his XJ-2 to investigate the [[fire]]s at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] caused by the [[501st Legion]]'s [[Operation: Knightfall|attack]] on the [[Jedi Order]] as part of the beginning [[Great Jedi Purge]] orchestrated by Palpatine. When Organa landed his speeder on a platform at the Temple, he was stopped by [[Clone Commander]] [[Appo]], who advised him to leave. Organa then watched Appo and his [[clone trooper]]s gun down [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Zett Jukassa]] and fled the scene in his XJ-2. In the following days, Organa witnessed Palpatine's [[Proclamation of the New Order]]. Disgusted with what he saw, he aided and abetted [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]]'s [[duel in the Senate]] against now-[[Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine. The assassination attempt failed, however, and Organa used his speeder to pick up Yoda fleeing through the [[Imperial Senate Building]]'s maintenance shafts.<ref name="ROTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:OnderonSpeederArt-FR.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Concept art for the recolored speeder in "Front Runners"]]
The XJ-2 airspeeder was created for [[George Lucas]]'s [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], where it was used as a mode of transport for Bail Organa's character. Lucas based the speeder on the [[Wikipedia:1948 Tucker Sedan|1948 Tucker Sedan]] and intended it to be a reference to the film [[Wikipedia:Tucker: The Man and His Dream|''Tucker: The Man and His Dream'']].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith">{{Film|III}} DVD commentary, Chapter 42</ref>

Organa's speeder later appeared in the [[2010]] episode "[[Pursuit of Peace]]" [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''.<ref name="Pursuit of Peace" /> Concept art of the speeder for the episode was done by [[Russell G. Chong]] and finished on [[August 5]], [[2008]].<ref name="Pursuit EG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/pursuit-of-peace-episode-guide|text="Pursuit of Peace" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref> A recolored version of the speeder later appeared in the [[2012]] [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] episode "[[Front Runners]]",<ref name="Front Runners" /> with the model having been designed by [[Kilian Plunkett]].<ref name="FrontRunners EG">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/front-runners-episode-guide|text="Front Runners" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref>

In the current canon the XJ-2 airspeeder was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="VE" /> The name had originally been introduced in the speeder's entry in the now-defunct [[StarWars.com]] Databank, authored by "[[Master Devwi]]" through the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] "[[What's The Story?]]" feature.<ref name="db">{{DB|vehicle|bailspeeder|airspeeder, Bail Organa's}}</ref> The [[StarWars.com]] episode guide for "Front Runners" misidentifies the airspeeder as a [[landspeeder]].<ref name="FrontRunners EG" />
